title: Network is $149 plus $59 a chapter with a Founding year, a yearly package and two worlds
detail: Owner rulings 2026-10-20 (Pricing structure analysis thread): Partner Network $149 + $59 per chapter, three to start, nonprofit $119 + $47; Founding is a year for nine months, first year, ends Jan 1; yearly package 10 chapters pay 8 ($6,210, nonprofit $4,950) with no Founding stack; Independent Network is a sales-led tier (price pending). Coupons and prices live in Stripe; migration repoints pricing_stripe_prices. See ADR-1815. Stripe objects created live 2026-10-20 (prices price_1USlPE.. through price_1USlQb.., coupons network-founding-year, nonprofit-network-founding-year, network-package-year, nonprofit-network-package-year). Independent Network: yearly agreement from $30,000 plus $5,000 setup (owner took the recommended figure). Migration 20270346019500 repoints price rows and sets three included chapters; apply before merge. Old prices ($599 etc.) archive after merge. Follow-up: the page-editor pricing template (lib/page-editor/templates/pricing.ts) still lists 'Talk to us to set it up' as a Network feature; changing it moves the /pricing visual fingerprint, so it waits for the next baseline recapture (e2e-manual.yml, update_baselines, then pnpm gen:visual-fingerprints). Migration 20270346019500 applied to production 2026-10-20 (Daniel ran the paste); /pricing visual baselines recaptured and fingerprints re-stamped by e2e-manual.yml the same day.
